title: 1969 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Rooster
seo_title: 1969 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Rooster (17 February – 5 February 1970)
description: 1969 is the Year of the Earth Rooster (Yin, Ji-you), from 17 February 1969 to 5 February 1970. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1969.
lead: Born in 1969? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rooster, but check the date: the 1969 Earth Rooster year began on 17 February 1969. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1969: Year of the Earth Rooster, from 17 February 1969 to 5 February 1970.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1969 was the Year of the Rooster. It began with Lunar New Year on 17 February 1969 and ended on 5 February 1970, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1969 ends in 9, which makes it an Earth year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1969 is a Ji-you year. The same Earth Rooster combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1909 before it and 2029 after it.
Lunar New Year 1969 fell on 17 February 1969, so everyone born in January 1969, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Monkey.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rooster guide describes the sign like this: “Observant, hard-working, and confident. Roosters are detail-oriented and take pride in doing things well.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly critical or blunt with others.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Rooster page.
Careers often linked with the Rooster: accounting, journalism, quality control, public speaking.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1969
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rooster's best matches are the Ox, Snake and Dragon, and its clash sign is the Rabbit, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rooster, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rooster, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rooster years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1957 (Fire Rooster); 1981 (Metal Rooster); 1993 (Water Rooster). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1969 is the Year of the Rooster, a Yin Earth Rooster year (Ji-you).
When does the 1969 Year of the Rooster start and end?
It starts on 17 February 1969 and ends on 5 February 1970.
I was born in January 1969. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Monkey: Lunar New Year 1969 was on 17 February 1969, so all of January 1969 belongs to the Monkey year.
Earth. 1969 ends in 9, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Rooster compatible with?
Traditionally the Ox, Snake and Dragon. The Rooster's clash sign is the Rabbit.
